title: Greedy Alignment Principle for Optimizer Hyperparameter Selection
abstract: arXiv:2512.06370v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent works have shown that gradient-update alignment is a powerful signal for modulating optimizer updates, often leading to faster training. We promote this update-wise heuristic as a mathematically grounded principle for selecting and tuning optimizer hyperparameters. By treating gradients and updates as signals and an optimizer as a causal filter that maps between them, we formulate optimizer selection as maximizing the expected drop rate in loss over a prescribed family of optimizers. We show that this objective is exactly the inner product between the optimizer filter and the gradient autocorrelation, and prove that a greedy optimum exists and has a stability bound under perturbations of the estimated gradient statistics. Specializing in momentum-based optimizers, the theory yields simple dynamic momentum selection rules for both SGD+Momentum and Adam/AdamW. translated_title: 面向优化器超参数选择的贪心对齐原理
translated_abstract: 近期的研究表明，梯度-更新对齐是调节优化器更新的一个强大信号，通常能够带来更快的训练速度。我们将这一逐更新的启发式方法提升为一个具有严格数学依据的原理，用于选择和调整优化器超参数。通过将梯度和更新视为信号，并将优化器视为在两者之间进行映射的因果滤波器，我们将优化器选择问题形式化为在一组给定的优化器族上最大化损失的期望下降速率。我们证明该目标恰好等于优化器滤波器与梯度自相关函数之间的内积，并证明了贪心最优解的存在性，且在估计的梯度统计量受到扰动时具有稳定性界。针对基于动量的优化器，该理论为 SGD+Momentum 和 Adam/AdamW 都推导出了简单的动态动量选择规则。在图像分类、语言模型微调等多项任务上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了贪心对齐原理，将优化器选择形式化为最大化损失期望下降速率（等价于优化器滤波器与梯度自相关的内积），证明了贪心最优解的存在性与稳定性，并据此为 SGD+Momentum 和 Adam/AdamW 导出了简单的动态动量选择规则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a greedy alignment principle that formalizes optimizer selection as maximizing the expected loss drop rate—shown to equal the inner product between the optimizer filter and gradient autocorrelation—proves existence and stability of the greedy optimum, and derives simple dynamic momentum selection rules for SGD+Momentum and Adam/AdamW.
